notes.title: Hit, Stand… Save! Credits & UI Update
notes.content:
✉️ Greetings from Norrland – The Land of the Midnight Sun

Greetings from Norrland in Sweden — the land of the midnight sun! ☀️  

Up here it's basically 24 hours of sunshine a day*, so what better time to stay indoors and update a blackjack game? 😉

(*Well... close enough.)



🛠️ What’s New in This Patch

Here’s what’s been updated in the latest build:



🎵 More Music

• More background music tracks added — let the cards fall to the beat of the music.



🌍 New Font with Expanded Language Support

• The in-game font has been changed to better support many more Latin-based languages.  

• This improves UI consistency and prepares for future translations.



🎨 UI Improvements 

• Button positions adjusted  

• Text windows refined for readability



💾 Credits Now Save Between Sessions

• This was a requested feature by players — thank you!  

• Your credits will now persist when quitting and restarting the game.  

• You can still press “New Game” to start over with 100 credits.



💀 Hard Mode – No More Auto Hand Counting

• In Hard difficulty, the card counter is now hidden!  

• You’ll have to keep track of your total manually — just like at a real blackjack table.  

• Good luck… and maybe bring a calculator. 😉



🌐 New Languages Added

We’ve started expanding support for more Latin-alphabet languages.

notes.title: The House Always Wins – But Not on Steam
notes.content:
🎲 Hello my friends!

My first game on Steam, Hit and Stand Blackjack, is here to teach you a valuable life lesson:

The only way to be sure you don't lose… is to not play.

Blackjack, in general, is a game where the house always has the edge.

But winners don't gamble with real money💸.  
If you're going to play Blackjack – do it safely, do it for fun, do it with Hit and Stand Blackjack. 😉

Stats no one asked for (but Steam tracks anyway): 📊

Revenue: $0 💸  
Players: A few brave souls 😂
Median playtime: 9 glorious minutes 🎉  


But hey, at least it's free! 😎  
Come join the club – and maybe you'll even stay for a 10th minute.

And if you do end up playing:  
💬 Every review – serious, silly, or somewhere in between – is genuinely appreciated.  
It lets me know someone out there actually clicked “Play.” 🎮


Hit smart.  
Stand proud.  
 Or just close the game. That works too.😉


🎉 Bonus news:  
A small update is coming later this month – so small you probably won’t even notice it.  
But hey, that’s part of the magic.

notes.title: Achievement Fix + Save Settings Overhaul
notes.content:
Upcoming Patch – Achievement Fixes, New Music & Settings Reset
Hi everyone!

A new update is scheduled to go live on 🗓️ 2025-05-22 at 20:00 (CET / Swedish time).

Thanks so much for your patience — I’ve been away on a short holiday for a few days, but I’m back now and ready to roll out an important update.

This patch addresses a number of issues with the Achievement system, adds new music, and resets the way settings are saved — which helps support multiple users more reliably going forward.

 What’s Changing
"Quit While Ahead" was not unlocking correctly for some players due to a bug where the system missed the unlock trigger. This has been fixed.

The Achievement Manager now automatically syncs with Steam every 5 minutes — so if an achievement doesn’t register right away, it will be retried in the background.

A final sync now runs when you quit the game, ensuring any just-earned achievements are sent to Steam before the game exits.

Achievements and stats are now saved per Steam user on your computer, meaning if you switch Steam accounts, the system won’t grant achievements that were earned by someone else.

Offline play is supported — achievements will be saved locally and synced the next time you’re online.

🎵 Two new background music tracks have been added!

⚠️ Settings Reset Warning
To support proper per-user saving, the system has changed.
As a result, the following settings will be reset for all players after the update:

Language
Difficulty level.
Music volume.
Total game time counter. (This refers to in-game time used for the “One Hour” achievement — not your total Steam playtime.)

Sorry for the inconvenience — this is a one-time change that ensures future saves are more robust and Steam-aware.

🚀 The update will go live today, May 22 at 20:00 Swedish time (CEST).
